instruction: Please help me disable the "ctrl+p" keyboard shortcut for Quick Open in VS Code to prevent shortcut conflicts.

metadata.explanation: This variation asks to remove the ctrl+p shortcut for Quick Open (workbench.action.quickOpen) instead of the original ctrl+f for Tree view Find. This is a commonly used shortcut that users might want to disable to avoid conflicts. The evaluator checks if the keybindings.json file contains the expected entry that disables this shortcut.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable ctrl+p shortcut
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches keybindings.json from VM
Metric (check_json_keybindings) correctly checks if expected keybinding entry exists in JSON array
Expected value is semantically correct: {"key": "ctrl+p", "command": "-workbench.action.quickOpen"} properly represents disabling the Quick Open shortcut
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
Data flow is correct: file retrieval → JSON parsing with fallback for comments → exact dict match verification
No postconfig needed - keybindings file state is persistent after task completion

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_keybindings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_keybindings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
